newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union sees Q1 profits higher.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union sees Q1 profits higher.

text.p: British insurance group Commercial Union said on Tuesday it expected to report higher profits for the first quarter of 1997 compared to its first quarter profits in the previous year.

"Our businesses are again developing in line with our plans this year and we are in particular seeing another strong increase in new life businesses," John Carter, the chief executive of Commercial Union, told shareholders at its annual general meeting.
Carter said its results would get a boost from the mild winter weather in the northern hemisphere including northern America.
"This will help us to report next month a good increase in profits compared to the first quarter of 1996," Carter told shareholders.
